title: Go to Line (gg, G, :number)
instruction_text:
Jump to any line instantly!

'gg' = go to first line
'G'  = go to last line
':5' then ENTER = go to line 5

Your task: Delete lines 3, 5, and 7.

Steps:
1. Type ':3' and press ENTER (jumps to line 3)
2. Press 'dd' to delete it
3. Type ':4' and press ENTER (was line 5, now line 4)
4. Press 'dd'
5. Type ':5' and press ENTER (was line 7, now line 5)
6. Press 'dd'
7. Save and quit with :wq

Try 'gg' and 'G' to jump to top/bottom!
